summary: This React component wraps blog post content in a styled div container. It uses a hook to check whether we're viewing a full blog post page versus a preview, and conditionally adds an ID that's used by the feed generation system to locate the main content.

explanations.7: useBlogPost() is a custom hook that gives us information about the current blog post context, including isBlogPostPage which tells us if we're on the full post page or just viewing a preview.
explanations.11: We only add the special ID when viewing the full blog post page; if it's just a preview or list view, we pass undefined so the ID won't appear in the DOM at all.
explanations.12: clsx combines multiple CSS class names together — here we're always applying 'markdown' class and optionally adding any extra classes passed in through the className prop.
